question: What sacred formulas should be written on the right side according to this instruction?
premises: The Kāma-tantra and Kāma-mantra are specified
The right side is the location
inference: One should write the Kāma-tantra and Kāma-mantra on the right side.
uncertainties: The meaning of kuśītena as the writing medium is unclear.
plain_english: O my beloved, one should write the Kāma-tantra and the Kāma-mantra with something cool on the right side.
